_comment: Canonical command manifest, shared by the GUI (reads this directly) and the bridge mod (reads a generated Lua mirror — see shared/sync_commands.py). Edit this file, then rerun sync_commands.py and repack the mod. 'confidence' is honest: 'verified-pattern' = a widely-documented BG3SE recipe, still test it once; 'needs-testing' = plausible but the exact Osiris/Ext call signature is NOT guaranteed correct for the current game version — paste it into the in-game dev console (bin/ScriptExtenderSettings.json already has CreateConsole:true) and fix the call before trusting the button.

commands.label: God Mode: ON
commands.description: Applies the SG_Immortal status (0 HP survival) to every player character. Community-standard invulnerability trick.
commands.lua:
local n = 0
for _, guid in ipairs(ctx.players()) do
  Osi.ApplyStatus(guid, 'SG_Immortal', -1, 0)
  n = n + 1
end
return 'god mode ON for ' .. n .. ' character(s)'

commands.label: God Mode: OFF
commands.description: Removes SG_Immortal from every player character.
commands.lua:
local n = 0
for _, guid in ipairs(ctx.players()) do
  Osi.RemoveStatus(guid, 'SG_Immortal')
  n = n + 1
end
return 'god mode OFF for ' .. n .. ' character(s)'

commands.label: Full Heal Party
commands.description: Writes MaxHp into Hp directly on the Health component for every player character (modern BG3SE ECS entity access).
commands.lua:
local n = 0
for _, guid in ipairs(ctx.players()) do
  local e = Ext.Entity.Get(guid)
  if e and e.Health then
    e.Health.Hp = e.Health.MaxHp
    e:Replicate('Health')
    n = n + 1
  end
end
return 'healed ' .. n .. ' character(s)'

commands.label: Revive Downed Companions
commands.description: Removes the KNOCKED_OUT / DOWNED status and tops up HP. Exact status name varies by game version — verify in console first.
commands.lua:
local n = 0
for _, guid in ipairs(ctx.players()) do
  Osi.RemoveStatus(guid, 'KNOCKED_DOWN')
  local e = Ext.Entity.Get(guid)
  if e and e.Health then
    e.Health.Hp = math.max(1, math.floor(e.Health.MaxHp * 0.5))
    e:Replicate('Health')
  end
  n = n + 1
end
return 'attempted revive on ' .. n .. ' character(s)'

commands.label: Add Gold
commands.description: Gold in BG3 is a currency item template, not a raw stat. This calls Osi.TemplateAddTo with a placeholder gold template GUID — replace GOLD_TEMPLATE with the real one (findable via the console: search item templates for 'Gold').
commands.lua:
local target = ctx.players()[1]
if not target then return 'no player character found' end
local amount = params.amount or 500
local ok = Osi.TemplateAddTo('GOLD_TEMPLATE_REPLACE_ME', target, amount, 1)
return 'add gold -> ' .. tostring(ok) .. ' (verify GOLD_TEMPLATE_REPLACE_ME first)'

commands.label: Add XP
commands.description: Attempts to grant XP via the Osiris XP-related function. Exact function name should be confirmed in-game (look for XP-related entries via console help/autocomplete).
commands.lua:
local target = ctx.players()[1]
if not target then return 'no player character found' end
local amount = params.amount or 1000
local ok = pcall(function() Osi.AddXP(target, amount) end)
return 'add xp -> ' .. tostring(ok) .. ' (verify Osi.AddXP exists in your version)'

commands.label: Add Camp Supplies
commands.description: Camp supplies are tracked per-party; exact Osiris call needs confirming against docs/console.
commands.lua:
local amount = params.amount or 100
local ok = pcall(function() Osi.CampAddSupplies(amount) end)
return 'add camp supplies -> ' .. tostring(ok) .. ' (verify Osi.CampAddSupplies exists)'

commands.label: Long Rest Anywhere
commands.description: Forces a long rest without needing to be at camp. Verify the exact Osiris story function name in console first.
commands.lua:
local ok = pcall(function() Osi.ForceLongRest() end)
return 'long rest -> ' .. tostring(ok) .. ' (verify Osi.ForceLongRest exists)'

commands.label: Spawn Item by Template ID
commands.description: Osi.TemplateAddTo(templateGUID, target, amount, addToParty) is a well-documented signature for spawning an item into an inventory. Pass the template GUID as the 'template' param.
commands.lua:
local target = ctx.players()[1]
if not target then return 'no player character found' end
if not params.template or params.template == '' then return 'set a template id first' end
local ok = Osi.TemplateAddTo(params.template, target, params.amount or 1, 1)
return 'spawn item -> ' .. tostring(ok)
